messages:
Maya Torres: Folks — Montero needs the SIG upload for procurement. They specifically called out Q2.1 (encryption at rest), Q3.2 (key rotation proof), and Q8.4 (incident response notifications). Can we split ownership? Need final bundle by Monday COB.
Ravi Singh: I can cover encryption-at-rest. We have `encryption-architecture.pdf` and a storage config snippet. Will prep a short cover note explaining AES-GCM + disk encryption.
Nina Gomez: I'll take key rotation evidence. There's a KMS rotation policy doc and a recent rotation audit `kms-audit-20250112.log`. I'll sanitize and push.
Caleb Wright: Incident response notes — I can supply the incident runbook excerpt and our notification SLA matrix. Also confirm whether we can share redacted timeline from last year's incident for evidence. Legal said redacted timeline OK.
Maya Torres: Great. Can sec-bot or ops-bot produce shareable links once files are uploaded? Also flag any items that need legal review.
sec-bot: Starting ingestion. Please tag files with customer=montero.
ops-bot: Reminder: Any file containing user identifiers must be scrubbed before upload. Use `hash-ids` pattern.
Ravi Singh: Draft attached locally: `encryption-architecture-v2.pdf` (AES-256 at rest, disk-level LUKS on self-hosted nodes, cloud KMS envelope encryption). Will remove internal diagrams.
Nina Gomez: Uploading `kms-rotation-policy.md` and `kms-audit-20250112.log` to secure share now. Will hash key IDs in the log.
sec-bot: Uploaded objects: https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/encryption-architecture-v2.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/kms-rotation-policy.md, https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/kms-audit-20250112-hashed.log
Caleb Wright: Incident docs sanitized and uploaded: https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/incident-runbook-excerpt.pdf, https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/notification-sla-matrix.csv
Maya Torres: Thanks — quick mapping so I can fill SIG: Q2.1 -> Ravi (encryption doc), Q3.2 -> Nina (KMS policy + audit), Q8.4 -> Caleb (runbook + SLA). Any objections?
Ravi Singh: All good. One note for the Q2.1 answer: we should explicitly state key management separation of duties (KMS access separated from deployment owners). I'll drop that sentence for the SIG answer.
Nina Gomez: Legal flagged that the KMS audit log contains internal hostnames. I've removed them and replaced with `host-<hash>`. ETA: all scrubbed version is live.
sec-bot: Updated object: https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/kms-audit-20250112-cleaned.log
Caleb Wright: Procurement also asked about encryption for backups. Added a short backup policy excerpt to the upload. https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/backup-encryption-policy.pdf
Maya Torres: Timeline: I'll draft the SIG sheet tonight and post for review tomorrow morning. If legal needs >24hrs on any redaction, I'll note pending attachments in the form.
Ravi Singh: Also — Montero asked if POC Dedicated pricing is available. For a 3-week PoC with burst to 2x GPUs we usually quote $12k flat + usage. I'll include as ballpark but advise contract team for final.
Caleb Wright: One potential blocker: SOC attestation snippet requested in Q5. Procurement expects evidence of SOC2. We have an exec summary but legal requires a signed NDA before release to show parts of the SOC report. Should we ask Montero to sign the NDA?
Maya Torres: Good catch. I'll add a conditional note in the SIG response: "SOC2 exec summary attached; full report available upon NDA."
Nina Gomez: Everything I uploaded is available. Sec-bot link again: https://s3.redwood.internal/montero/ (files: kms-rotation-policy.md, kms-audit-20250112-cleaned.log)
sec-bot: All artifacts verified for checksum and tags.
Maya Torres: I'll assemble and paste the completed SIG answers here for a quick one-pass before we submit. Please watch for my message tomorrow AM. Thanks team :rocket:
